metadata.loss: source-uniform weighted physical squared XY displacement plus ridge penalty
metadata.reference_frame: camera/task XY; scene rotations require co-rotating reference_angle
metadata.representation: endpoint envelope 4p(1-p), degree zero/one, standardized reference-frame direction, local SI residual

selection.selection_rule: Lowest source-uniform LOO mean displacement; choose six coefficients when within strictly 0.1mm of best

metric_interpretation: Approximate optical XY displacement; validation diagnostic only; no test labels consumed
